# gramlot-py-server 0.3.16

Add Tools and IDE to the Python gallery using a disposable sample-document workspace. Draft editing is available without persistence. Remote Edit is off by default; only an explicit --remote-edit startup option allows writes to the sample workspace. Filesystem RPCs enforce configured roots, reject traversal/symlinks and verify revisions on save. Python files are text documents and are never executed by these endpoints. All five adapters share the same behavior.
